bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (p.75)

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

options.name: Aspiring Champion
options.text: An Aspiring Champion is a Chaos Space Marine who leads a band of heretic Astartes. They have the following additional Wargear and Ruin Action.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to Charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

options.name: Plague Marine (Legions of Chaos, p.343)
options.text: A Plague Marine of the Death Guard is identical to a Chaos Space Marine, with the following changes: Toughness 8, Wounds 12, Resilience 14, Speed 5. DETERMINATION: Disgustingly Resilient. You do not need to spend Ruin to roll Determination for this Threat. Roll 8d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Noxious Discharge
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat takes a Wound, roll a d6. If you roll an Icon, a mix of virulent gasses and toxic effluent spills from the Wound. The Noxious Discharge hits every target Engaged with the Death Guard. Noxious Discharge: 2 +4 ED / AP –4 / Blast (4), Inflict (Poison 4)
